meta.source: desktop/design/tokens.json (gt1-tone-matcher repo); app CSS generated by desktop/scripts/build-tokens.mjs

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Window background behind panels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, the header and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the selected slot's detail, result cards that just arrived.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: text fields, selects, knob tracks, empty slot cells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between groups and panel edges. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, switches). 3:1 on surface and well.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-raised and well.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, engraved panel labels on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels on surface and well. Meets 4.5:1 on surface; keep it off canvas for running text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Valve amber: the one primary action per view, the active pipeline step, the target slot. Fill only; text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected-state fill: chosen slot cell, active segment. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: the patch name readout, links, the active step label, on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: led
tokens.usage: A lit status LED and the knob arc. Small marks only, never text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Written and verified: done steps, the 'cihaza yazıldı' state, a connected GT-1. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look but nothing failed: unsure readings, BTS open, an untested platform. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or destructive: errors, overwrite warnings, stop. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. Blue so it never reads as a selected (amber) state.

tokens.name: console-bg
tokens.usage: The output console: dark in both themes, like the GT-1's screen.

tokens.name: console-ink
tokens.usage: Console text on console-bg.

tokens.name: console-dim
tokens.usage: Console warnings and library noise (stderr) on console-bg.

tokens.name: console-cmd
tokens.usage: The echoed command line in the console.

tokens.name: console-ok
tokens.usage: Console success line.

tokens.name: console-err
tokens.usage: Console error line.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-state headline only. Archivo at width 112.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Do I Wanna Know? · Arctic Monkeys

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gitarını EADGBE akortla, pitch shifter yok.
styles.usage: All running text and control text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Values that matter inside body text: amp model, tuning.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Engraved panel labels: field labels, knob names, panel heads. Uppercase, Archivo at width 118, ink-muted.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Slot numbers, knob values, timings: anything the GT-1 shows as a number.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: The slot a patch went to, on result cards.

styles.name: patch-name
styles.usage: GT-1 patch names (16 characters, uppercase) in accent-ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, LED to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact controls; gap in button rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to control; gap between fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between fields stacked.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on result cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; view padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; separation of major regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, chips, slot cells: machined, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the console.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: LEDs, switch tracks and thumbs, status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and cards: a lit top edge like a faceplate.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Sunken controls: inputs, knob tracks, slot cells.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers.
